description.intro: The Nike 3a Barcelona kids 26 27 Dri-Fit Stadium Shorts complete the FC Barcelona children's third kit for the 2026/27 season. It combines details inspired by the equipment used by the team with a construction designed to offer comfort to young fans. Its elastic waist with drawstring allows you to easily adjust the support, while its 100% polyester construction provides a lightweight garment ready for both playing football and cheering on Barça.
key_benefits: Comfort during play: Its lightweight construction facilitates movement during activity.
Sweat Management: Helps draw moisture away from the skin to keep you feeling drier.
Custom fit: The elastic waist with drawstring allows you to comfortably adjust the fit.
Match style: The Stadium collection incorporates replica details inspired by the team's kit.
Blaugrana passion: Ideal to complete the FC Barcelona 2026/27 third children's kit.
